primary.title: Equity vs debt mutual fund taxation: How your MF gains are taxed in India
primary.summary: Mutual fund taxation in India varies by fund type and holding period. Equity funds face different tax rates for short-term and long-term gains, while debt funds purchased after April 1, 2023, are taxed at income tax slab rates. Details here.
